Notes: Expand inheritance transitively, unioning overlapping lines and roles within each node. In n55, `Terminal.cursor` stores terminal-wide appearance defaults; the active `Screen.cursor` holds position. In n57, the alternate screen is lazy, but reset can remove it and resize can recreate it if the active alternate fails to resize (`src/terminal/Terminal.zig:4981-5047`, verified). In n65, pins follow retained content; when content is erased or pruned, pins are relocated and may be marked `garbage`. An unscrolled viewport uses the `.active` marker rather than a pin lookup.
